approved_text: Let ε_n be the supremum of ε such that residues a_p can be chosen for the primes n^ε < p ≤ n with every integer in [1,n] congruent to a_p mod p for some such p. Find f(n) with f = O(ε_n) and ε_n = O(f). Does ε_n → 0?
draft: Let ε_n be the largest ε such that one can choose residues a_p for all primes n^ε < p ≤ n with every integer in [1,n] congruent to a_p mod p for some such p. Find f(n) with f = O(ε_n) and ε_n = O(f). Is ε_n → 0 as n → ∞?
source_docstrings:
